description: Ingest knowledge from files, optionally memorizing it all. Documents are chunked and stored as episodic memories. Use --memorize flag to add all chunks to spaced repetition queue.

result_processor_customizations.result_description: Results of document ingestion including memories created and optionally memorized
result_processor_customizations.output_action_guidance: Determine the appropriate next action based on the context and action result.

error_processor_customizations.action_context: Ingesting knowledge from files into episodic memories
error_processor_customizations.error_interpretation: FileNotFoundError: the specified path does not exist. NoFilesMatchedError: no files matched the pattern in the directory. EmbeddingError: failed to generate embeddings for document chunks.
error_processor_customizations.recovery_guidance: For file not found: verify the path exists and is accessible. For no files matched: check the glob pattern matches files in the directory. For embedding errors: verify embedding service is available.
